d:
Ameriki midtarm chunav men donald tranp ki ripablikan parti ko bara jhatka laga hai. demokrets ne sinet aur haus of riprejentetivs men bahumat hasil kar liya hai. isse tranp ke lie apne bache hue karyakal men faisle lena mushkil ho sakta hai. lekin ameriki rajniti men is badlav ka asar sirf amerika tak simit nahin rahega. eeran, chin, rus aur khari deshon ke lie iske kya mayne hain? kya tranp ki kamzor hoti rajnitik sthiti se in deshon ko apni ranniti badalne ka mauqa milega? bibisi ke patrakaron se samjhie.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
